checks.note: Key uses manifest-assigned serverId; serverInfo.name is only logged. add() rejects an existing key instead of overwriting (registry.ts:138-142). server.ts:49 passes the literal 'ehr' id.

Cross-server exact bare-name duplicates and canonicalised (case, homoglyph, separator, rn/m) edit-distance-1 lookalikes are rejected and recorded as conflicts. Native tools are registered first so MCP tools are checked against them. No silent overwrite.

Only manifest servers can register. Allowlist and approvals use the namespaced key (call.name, e.g. ehr__x) via executor.ts:55 and approvals.ts:75. A new server cannot take an approved key because duplicates are rejected.

note: Tools are keyed by manifest serverId plus tool name, duplicates and lookalikes across servers are rejected, and allowlist and approval use the namespaced key, so I found no way to break any of the three checks.
